name: The SIMPLE Phase II Dark Matter Search

summary.plain: The full write-up of SIMPLE Phase II. After removing installation-period data that had been included by mistake, the science exposure is 18.24 kg days and the limits are slightly better.
summary.technical: Removal of the 1.94 kg d Stage 1 installation data reduces the science exposure from 20.18 to 18.24 kg d; detection efficiency better than 97% (95% C.L.) and recoil identification better than 99%; the results are re-examined with respect to the fluorine spin and halo parameters.

title: The SIMPLE Phase II Dark Matter Search
why_it_matters: The abstract describes the paper as the detailed account of the Phase II detectors, instrumentation, analysis and data selection; it supersedes the 2012 numbers for the same data.
